body.statement: Conditional on \(\mathrm{oeq:score-lifting-completeness}\), if \(T_a\) and \(T_a^*\) are bijective for \(a=0,1\), then \(\mathcal N_a(P)=\mathcal K_a(P)=\{0\}\), \(\mathcal C_P=\{0\}\), \(\Phi_P=\{\phi_{h,q}\}\), and \(\phi_{\mathrm{eff}}=\phi_{h,q}\). Thus the quotient bound reduces to CuiEtAl2024SemiparametricProximal Theorem \(3.1\).
body.justification: The reduction is the standard-case sanity check once the general score-lifting obligation is discharged.
body.gap: CuiEtAl2024SemiparametricProximal establishes the unique-and-surjective endpoint; this theorem verifies exact nesting without imposing those restrictions on the main model.
body.consumer: Existing proximal software remains efficiency-valid when diagnostics support unique bijective bridge operators.
